meta.description: Infer cis-regulatory connections (peak-to-peak co-accessibility) from scATAC-seq using Cicero, ArchR getCoAccessibility, or SCENIC+, and map them to enhancer-gene candidates.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; planted truth recovered and independent recomputations match; unsourced ranges are labelled as heuristics

practice_boundaries.detail: Research analysis guidance; no clinical claims

methodological_ground.detail: Co-accessibility framed as a hypothesis generator, not 3D contact; SCENIC+ stated as not executed

code_usability.detail: CLI and function ran on pattern .mtx, multi-chromosome and larger slices; the zero-read failure is loud, not silent (COACC-014)

functional_suitability.note: Cicero, ArchR, planted-truth recovery, multi-chromosome and downstream snippets all work; LinkPeaks, Hi-C, SCENIC+ and reference databases remain prose or unshipped, honestly labelled

reliability.note: Early guards, seed, empty-set handling and deterministic output; a zero-read cell halts with a cryptic error (COACC-014); whole-genome run untested

performance_context.note: 51-line SKILL.md with routed references; runtime scaling is documented for the chr1 case only

agent_usability.note: Clear tool selection table with per-route execution status; version guidance now consistent; one usage-guide prompt contradicts the TSS window (COACC-015)

human_usability.note: Readable tables and status column; inputs need strict formats with limited recovery guidance

security.note: No credentials or string execution; file arguments unchecked beyond existence

maintainability.note: Single script mixes CLI and pipeline but is now versioned, commented and internally consistent; no tests shipped

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger description and progressive disclosure; SCENIC+ route static-only and stated as such

inputs.label: Shipped CLI on real 3-chromosome PBMC Multiome ATAC slice (766 peaks x 2,701 cells, pattern-format .mtx) with 4th-arg TSS BED
inputs.note: exit 0 in 5.2 min; 1,121 strong pairs, 287 enhancer-gene rows; all independent checks pass

assertions.text: CLI exits 0 on a pattern-format binary .mtx and writes the connections TSV and enhancer-gene CSV (COACC-001)
Strong table has one row per unordered pair, scores in (0.25,1], anchors are input peak names, no cross-chromosome pairs, span within the 500 kb window (COACC-005/007)
enhancer column holds peak names and the set of enhancer-gene pairs equals an independent recomputation from the BED (COACC-002/009)
assertions.note: independent 287 vs csv 287; no integer codes; no duplicates

assertions.text: enhancer_is_promoter flag equals an independent TSS-window overlap of the enhancer peak
Multi-chromosome input runs through the peak-derived genome_df without cross-chromosome scoring (COACC-003)

inputs.label: run_cicero_pipeline API: window=1e6 (multi-chromosome), tss_bed=NULL branch, seed reproducibility
inputs.note: window=1e6 run 6.2 min; NULL-TSS and repeat runs byte-identical (sha256 72bec6f9...)

assertions.text: window=1e6 scores pairs beyond 500 kb and stays within the window measured end-to-start (COACC-006)
assertions.note: 15,077 scored pairs >500 kb; max gap 998,051 (start-to-start 1,010,898 is inside one peak width, peaks reach 67 kb)

assertions.text: No cross-chromosome pairs and all three chromosomes scored at window=1e6
tss_bed=NULL prints the skip message and writes only the connections TSV
assertions.note: no enhancer-gene file written; message seen

assertions.text: Same seed and input give an identical strong table across three fresh processes (tss on, tss off, repeat)
Scored-pair count is reported as unordered pairs with negatives counted

inputs.label: ArchR addCoAccessibility/getCoAccessibility as documented on public PBMC 5k chr1 slice
inputs.note: documented calls run verbatim; SimpleList wording verified

assertions.text: addCoAccessibility(k=100, knnIteration=500, maxDist=250000) completes on 835 cells / 1,876 peaks
getCoAccessibility(returnLoops=TRUE) returns a SimpleList whose element 1 is a GRanges (COACC-010)
returnLoops=FALSE returns a DataFrame of correlations within [0.5,1] respecting maxDist
Route is executed only where code ran (no claim for routes not run)
assertions.note: SKILL.md labels ArchR executed on a PBMC chr1 slice

inputs.label: Synthetic planted-truth dataset (60 peaks, 4 latent states, 4 co-varying peak groups) plus a threshold that leaves zero strong pairs
inputs.note: planted structure recovered exactly; empty strong set handled

assertions.text: Within-group planted pairs are strong
Cross-group and independent background pairs are not strong
Cross-group scores are negative or low relative to within-group (negatives retained, range -1..1) (COACC-007)
Threshold 0.999 (no strong pairs) with a TSS BED completes without crashing and writes header-only outputs
Two identical seeds reproduce the connections table byte for byte

inputs.label: Shipped CLI on the larger real PBMC 5k chr1:1-30 Mb slice (1,726 peaks x 3,277 cells, pattern .mtx)
inputs.note: exit 0 in 5.2 min (documented 8.5-14 min, load dependent); 6,035 strong / 2,027 enhancer-gene

assertions.text: CLI completes within the documented runtime range on the larger slice
All structural invariants hold (unique unordered pairs, scores, window, peak names)
Enhancer-gene set equals independent recomputation and promoter flag matches
Counts match the fix worker's earlier run (deterministic result)

inputs.label: Downstream doc snippets on the CLI output: locus arc plot (>0.5) and Hi-C concordance against a planted BEDPE
inputs.note: arc plot readable; concordance snippet matches independent expectation

assertions.text: Visualizing Connections snippet runs verbatim (locus, GenomeAxisTrack, >0.5 filter) and renders a readable arc figure (COACC-008)
assertions.note: 1400x500 png inspected: axis, 21 arcs anchored in window, no hairball

assertions.text: Hi-C concordance snippet count equals an independent orientation-agnostic overlap count on a planted BEDPE (30 real + 30 decoy loops)
Snippet is unaffected by lexicographic Peak1<Peak2 ordering (GenomicInteractions normalizes anchors)
assertions.note: 6 supported pairs had Peak1 genomically downstream; 0 missed

assertions.text: Unsourced concordance bands are labelled as heuristics, not benchmarks (COACC-011)

inputs.label: Failure guards: dimension mismatch, colon-format peak names, missing TSS BED, BED without gene column, and a cell with zero reads
inputs.note: four early clear guards (0.4 s); zero-read cell halts with a cryptic monocle3 error

assertions.text: Dimension mismatch is rejected before any long computation
chr:start-end peak names are rejected with the chr_start_end contract in the message (COACC-009)
Missing or gene-less TSS BED is rejected before the long run with a specific message
assertions.note: 'tss_bed not found' / 'needs the gene name in column 4'; all guards 0.4 s

assertions.text: Peak names, TSS and matrix guard failures do not write partial outputs or report success
A zero-read cell halts with an actionable message naming the cause (COACC-014)
assertions.note: error is 'attempt to set an attribute on NULL'; only monocle3's warning names the remedy

key_strengths: All prior P1/P2 defects reproduce as fixed on independent real-data runs: pattern .mtx CLI, enhancer names, unordered pairs, window, guards
Planted-truth recovery is exact (within-group 1.00 strong, cross-group 0.00) and outputs are byte-reproducible with the seed
Independent recomputation of the enhancer-gene table matches on both the 3-chromosome and the 30 Mb slices
Honest per-route execution status: SCENIC+ and prose-only routes are labelled as not executed

recommendations.title: Cryptic zero-read halt; conflicting TSS window prompt
recommendations.problem: A cell with no reads in the peak set stops the CLI with 'attempt to set an attribute on NULL' (only monocle3's warning names the cause), and a usage-guide prompt says tssRegion=c(-2000, 500) while the script and SKILL use TSS +/- 2 kb.
recommendations.root_cause: No guard for empty cells in run_cicero_pipeline and one prompt copied from ArchR conventions.
recommendations.fix: Fail early with a message naming zero-read cells (or drop them with a count) and align the prompt to TSS +/- 2 kb; not blocking.
